contract: DescribeCluster, log directories, partition reassignment, features, and quorum voter keys speak versions 0 and 1. Other keys and version 2 return unsupported and do not mutate.
A log-directory batch with one unknown directory stores nothing. A feature downgrade stores nothing. The last quorum voter cannot be removed.
A stale controller epoch stores nothing. Reopen restores the log directory, feature level, and remaining voter.
limits: The disposition table covers the named admin keys. It is not a per-version result for every key in the pinned broker matrix, and those other keys are unsupported rather than advertised as success.
This is not the Kafka admin RPC and it does not forward to a mixed-version controller cluster.
The journal format is the local PLADM001 snapshot.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
